releases.name: v0.3.0 - three cooperating skills, a clean reading copy, three hard gates
releases.notes:
v0.3.0 — three cooperating skills, a clean reading copy, three hard gates

This release turns the single research skill into a small family: the core deep
research skill plus two optional capability skills it hands work off to, with a
cleaner deliverable and a stricter delivery gate. It is the full diff from
v0.2.0.

## Three cooperating skills

- **`meld-deepresearch`** — the core research / evidence / citation loop. Still
 Python-standard-library only.
- **`meld-da`** — an Excel / spreadsheet data-analysis workflow (reading,
 cleaning, filtering, aggregation, statistics, charts, export), adapted from
 SenseNova-Skills' `sn-da-excel-workflow` (MIT) and reworked for portable use.
 Its Python packages are optional; without them it degrades to the built-in
 zero-dependency reader.
- **`meld-search-academic`** — academic search, paper full-text and section
 reading, and citation-tree tracing across arXiv, Semantic Scholar, Google
 Scholar, PubMed, Crossref, OpenAlex, SSRN, Wikipedia and more, adapted from
 `sn-search-academic` (MIT). Its browser-crawler tier is optional and degrades
 to the official APIs and then to generic search.

Cross-skill hand-offs are documented in `references/protocol.md` section 2a:
local table files plus analysis route to `meld-da`; academic, scientific or
historical subjects route the scholarly layer through `meld-search-academic`.

en.headline: sogeisetsu ships meld-deepresearch v0.3.1 and opens a harness-extensibility
en.summary: On 2026-10-06, `sogeisetsu` made **3 own commits** in `sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch`, plus 6 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. The three own commits cut the `v0.3.1` release, added high-intent search terms to the skill descriptions in the docs, and made the academic degrade test dependency-aware so draw gate 3 fires correctly. No pull requests or reviews were filed. One issue was opened: `OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-Skills-DeepResearch` #11, proposing to make the harness extensible (supporting OpenCode/Pi and similar) and to consider exposing it as an MCP server. In `iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI` #458, `goworm` replied on the OpenCode v2 integration thread noting that the skills install path was already fixed in 1.0.140 (#254) so `officecli skills opencode` writes to `~/.config/opencode/skills/`, then closed the issue. `sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` gained 1 star, bringing the total to 1. The `v0.3.0` release of `sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` was published the prior day and is included for context.

releaseNotes.summary: Turns the single research skill into a family: the core `meld-deepresearch` skill plus optional `meld-da` (Excel/spreadsheet data analysis, adapted from SenseNova-Skills' `sn-da-excel-workflow`) and a third skill, with a cleaner reading copy and three hard delivery gates. Python-standard-library only for the core; `meld-da` degrades to a zero-dependency reader when its optional packages are absent. Full diff from v0.2.0.

zh.headline: sogeisetsu 发布 meld-deepresearch v0.3.1 并提交 harness 可扩展性 issue
zh.summary: 2026-10-06 当天，`sogeisetsu` 在 `sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` 完成 **3 次本人提交**，另有 6 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 自动提交。三次本人提交分别切出 `v0.3.1` 版本、在技能描述中补充高意图搜索词，以及让学术降级测试依赖感知，使 draw gate 3 正确触发。当天没有提交 PR 或代码评审。新开了 1 个 issue：`OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-Skills-DeepResearch` #11，建议让 harness 可扩展（支持 OpenCode/Pi 等）并考虑以 MCP 形式对外暴露。在 `iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI` #458 中，`goworm` 回复 OpenCode v2 集成讨论，指出 skills 安装路径已在 1.0.140（#254）修复，`officecli skills opencode` 会写入 `~/.config/opencode/skills/`，随后关闭了该 issue。`sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` 新增 1 颗星，总数为 1。`sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` 的 `v0.3.0` 发布于前一天，此处一并列出以供参考。

releaseNotes.summary: 将单一研究技能扩展为一个技能家族：核心 `meld-deepresearch` 加上可选的 `meld-da`（Excel/表格数据分析，改编自 SenseNova-Skills 的 `sn-da-excel-workflow`）以及第三个技能，同时提供更干净的阅读副本和三个硬性交付门禁。核心仅依赖 Python 标准库；`meld-da` 在缺少可选依赖时会降级为零依赖读取器。相对 v0.2.0 的完整差异。
